ListMeta.description: Pagination details returned with a list of resources.

resourceVersion.description: Opaque version identifying the resource-list snapshot.

continue.description: Opaque token used to request the next page.

remainingItemCount.description: Number of resources remaining after the current page.

ResourceList.description: A paginated API response containing resources of one kind.

kind.description: Resource kind followed by List, such as ConnectionList.

items.description: Resources returned in the current page.

ActionMeta.description: Identifies the resource on which an action operates.

target.description: Reference to the resource on which the action operates.

Action.description: A request to perform an operation on a resource, optionally including its result.

metadata.description: Identifies the resource targeted by the action.

status.description: Result of the action when returned by the server.

ActionRequest.description: A typed action accepted from a client; server-owned status is forbidden.

ActionResponse.description: A typed action returned by the server, optionally including observed status.
